patterns.note: A single-column list layout dominates the page, with each item presented as a simple text link accompanied by a small, colorful icon or emoji.
The site uses a consistent, clean sans-serif typeface for all text, with the main page title being the largest and most prominent, followed by list item titles and then smaller labels.
A minimalist palette of white and black is accented by a vibrant, pastel-like array of colors used for filter buttons and small decorative icons/emojis, creating a playful contrast.

The initial hero graphic transforms from an orange blob to a red asterisk-like shape and then disappears as the user scrolls, while the main title and category filter buttons become sticky at the top of the viewport.
Informational sections, like the 'About' text and featured content cards, are presented as distinct, subtly rounded blocks with light background colors, breaking up the main list flow.

technique_notes: To rebuild the transforming hero, an initial large, organically shaped graphic should be present at the top of the page. As the user scrolls, this graphic should scale down, change its shape and color, and then animate out of view, revealing the content below. This can be achieved by linking scroll position to CSS transformations (scale, shape morph, opacity) on the hero element.

The header and category filters should initially be positioned statically. Upon reaching a certain scroll threshold, these elements should transition to a fixed position at the top of the viewport, maintaining their visibility as the user continues to scroll.

Content sections, such as the 'About' paragraph and the featured content cards, are presented as distinct blocks with subtle background tints and rounded corners, providing visual separation within the predominantly list-based layout.

design_tokens.type_scale: The main page title is a prominent, clean sans-serif (~2.5x body), while list items and body text use a standard, legible sans-serif. Labels and filter buttons are smaller, uppercase sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: subtle — used consistently for filter buttons and content cards, giving a soft edge to interactive and grouped elements.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced — the initial hero area is airy, but content lists and footer sections maintain a comfortable, consistent vertical rhythm without feeling overly dense or sparse.

standout: The site's distinctive feature is its playful and interactive hero graphic that transforms and guides the user to scroll, combined with the consistent use of small, colorful emoji-like icons to categorize and add personality to each list item. This creates a unique blend of minimalist content presentation with a whimsical, engaging user experience.
